name: [R27] CI/agentic-workflow private-repo read followed by public-facing write
message:
Exploratory heuristic for the pattern disclosed as "GitLost" (Noma Security, 2026-07-06): a public GitHub Issue's body contained hidden instructions that steered GitHub's Agentic Workflows into reading private-repository data and posting it back into a public thread. Noma gave no reusable signature for this; this rule is this repository's own constructed proxy -- a CI/agent-runner reading private-repo/secret-scoped context, then writing to a public-facing output (issue comment, PR comment, published artifact) within the same run.

Treat every hit as a lead, not a confirmation: this needs sequence correlation (same run_id, read-then-write) that this single query cannot fully express on its own -- build the join on run_id in your SIEM. Correlate with R9 (steered egress) and R11 (tool call with no direct user instruction) before escalating.

queries.name: public_write
queries.query: source:github @event_type:(issue_comment.create OR pull_request_comment.create OR pages.publish OR artifact.publish) @output.visibility:public

cases.name: Private-repo read and public-facing write seen from the same run_id within one workflow run (needs SIEM-side join on @run_id -- see rule message)
